The gym

Everything you need. Nothing you don't.

12,000 sq ft of training space on East 6th Street. We spend money on equipment and coaches — not on marble lobbies.

  • Free weights, racks & platforms — never a queue at peak hours
  • Cardio zone with treadmills, rowers, assault bikes & stair climbers
  • Showers, lockers and towel service included in every plan
  • Free on-site parking + bike racks right outside

Your first 12 weeks

The version of you in 12 weeks starts today

Nobody transforms by accident. Every IronWorks membership follows the same simple arc — show up, get coached, watch the numbers move. Your free week is step one.

01

Week 1 — Just walk in

Free pass, free locker, zero pressure. Tour the floor, try a class, meet a coach. The hardest rep is the first one.

02

Weeks 2–6 — Build the habit

A written starter plan and small classes capped at 14, so your form is fixed before bad habits set in.

03

Weeks 7–12 — See it move

Monthly progress check-ins track your lifts, measurements and energy — proof on paper that it's working.
